# Free AI Credits — Full Content

> Complete set of active free AI credit offers with summaries, claim context and source links — concatenated for LLM ingestion (Claude Code / Cursor). Generated at build time from src/data/offers.json and src/data/details.json.

Source: https://freetokens.custats.info/ — generated 2026-11-10T08:39:14Z — 123 of 256 active offers (truncated to stay under the 200KB llms-full budget; full directory at https://freetokens.custats.info/).

Trust fields: review_status, verification, signup, last_checked — the same schema values the short index defines at https://freetokens.custats.info/llms.txt. An offer's expiry date is its enrollment deadline — the last date to claim — not how long the credits stay valid. When a provider states how long claimed credits last, that term is in the amount text.

## Offers (full)

### ZCode / BigModel New-User Trial
- Provider: ZCode (Z.ai)
- Category: coding
- Amount: 8M tokens/day for the first 5 days (GLM-5.3 3M + GLM-5.3-Flash 5M) after connecting a BigModel account; then expires — not an ongoing free tier
- Status: active — enrollment deadline: none (ongoing)
- Last checked: 2026-11-10 — review_status=under-review · verification=social_proof · signup=required
- Source: https://zcode.z.ai/en/docs/configuration
- Page: https://freetokens.custats.info/offers/zcode-bigmodel-new-user-trial.html
- Summary: ZCode grants new users who connect a BigModel account a no-payment trial: 8 million tokens per day for the first 5 days (GLM-5.3 3M/day + GLM-5.3-Flash 5M/day). The daily quota refreshes during those 5 days and then expires — it is not an ongoing free tier. Intended for trying ZCode Agent before a GLM Coding Plan. The same docs say Z.ai (overseas) new users also get a free daily trial quota for flagship GLM models, but the 8M/5-day split is quoted only in the BigModel section. Distinct from Z.ai's ongoing Flash free APIs and the Z.ai Startups Program.
- Claim steps: Install/open ZCode and connect a BigModel account (welcome screen Continue with BigModel, or Settings → Model Settings). | New users receive the 5-day trial automatically with no payment; check remaining daily quota on the BigModel provider page. | After day 5 the trial quota expires; subscribe to a GLM Coding Plan (Lite/Pro/Max) in-app if you need more.

Sign-in via GitHub or Google is required. Every catalog model works. Personal accounts separately get $1 starter credit, no card required. The service is unavailable to users in mainland China.

- Category: api_provider
- Amount: Free Reflection AI Beam 1.0 on AI Gateway (reflection/beam-free, 1M context) for a limited launch period
- Status: active — enrollment deadline: none (ongoing)

- Page: https://freetokens.custats.info/offers/vercel-reflection-beam-free.html
- Summary: Vercel's AI Gateway offers Reflection AI's Beam 1.0, formerly the stealth model stealth/cat-jam, free for a limited time during its launch period when Reflection AI serves the request. Beam is an open-weight (Apache 2.0) reasoning model for coding and agentic work, with 501B total and 23B active parameters, a 1M-token context, up to 131K output tokens, tool calling and structured outputs. Use reflection/beam-free, which stops serving when the offer ends, so it cannot turn into a bill. reflection/beam is also free when routed to Reflection, but switches to paid pricing when the offer ends, and other providers serving it bill at their own rates. Use is subject to Reflection's terms and privacy policy; Vercel's live endpoint data marks Reflection as neither zero-data-retention nor no-training, so avoid sensitive inputs. No end date is stated. Whether a payment method is needed to create an AI Gateway key was not tested.
- Claim steps: Create a Vercel account and an AI Gateway API key. | Call model reflection/beam-free through the AI SDK, Chat Completions, Responses or Anthropic Messages API, or a coding agent connected to AI Gateway (npx vercel ai-gateway setup for Claude Code, Codex or Hermes). | Prefer reflection/beam-free: it stops serving when the free period ends instead of billing. If you use reflection/beam, pin provider reflection with only in the gateway provider options, and expect paid pricing after the launch period. | Reflection's terms and privacy policy apply; its endpoint is not marked zero-data-retention or no-training, so avoid sensitive code or data.

### Valyu — 1,000 Free API Credits a Month (2,000 with a Work Email)
- Provider: Valyu
- Category: api_provider
- Amount: 1,000 free credits/month (2,000 with a company email); work email needs no card, personal email must add a card (not charged) after month one; one balance for Search, Contents and DeepResearch; credits reset monthly, no rollover
- Status: active — enrollment deadline: none (ongoing)
- Last checked: 2026-11-10 — review_status=under-review · verification=social_proof · signup=required
- Source: https://docs.valyu.ai/pricing
- Page: https://freetokens.custats.info/offers/valyu-new-account-search-credits.html
- Summary: Valyu gives 1,000 free credits a month, or 2,000 when you sign up with a work (company) email. Work-email credits arrive at signup with no card; personal or university email accounts need nothing for the first month, then must add a card on the platform to keep the credits coming (adding a card does not charge it). One shared credit balance covers Search, Contents and DeepResearch. In your first month, the first 1,000 free credits with a work email (500 with a personal email) work on every source on Valyu's standard plans; after that, free monthly credits cover the pay-as-you-go sources (web search, arXiv and PubMed) and a plan unlocks the rest. Licensed sources outside the standard plans still need separate access. Free credits reset each month and unused credits do not roll over. Beyond the free allowance, pay-as-you-go top-ups start at $10 (1,600 credits per $10) and monthly plans unlock more sources. There are no overage charges: when the balance cannot cover a request, the API returns 402 Payment Required and does not run it.
- Claim steps: Sign up for a Valyu account; a work (company) email gets 2,000 free credits a month with no card, a personal or university email gets 1,000. | Try Search, Contents and DeepResearch. In your first month, the first 1,000 free credits with a work email (500 with a personal email) work on every standard-plan source; then free monthly credits cover web search, arXiv and PubMed. Licensed sources outside standard plans need separate access. | With a personal or university email, add a card on the platform after your first month to keep the free credits coming (it is not charged). Credits reset monthly with no rollover; when the balance runs out, requests return 402 until the next reset, a top-up ($10 minimum) or a plan.

Approved startups receive up to $15K, $30K, or $50K in free platform credits depending on funding stage (Build: up to $5M raised / Scale: $5–10M raised / Grow: over $10M raised). Credits can be used for serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, fine-tuning, and instant clusters, but do not apply to Reserved GPU Clusters.

The only free, no-deposit tier is Starter: up to $1,000 in Runware credits for bootstrapped and pre-seed companies with a working product. The award is not fixed: Runware scores each application on product, traction and how clearly inference fits, and awards credits in $100 steps up to $1,000. Starter credits do not expire and are usable across the platform (image, video, audio, 3D and LLM APIs, editing, serverless and compute) at standard pricing. The Growth and Scale tiers are deposit-matching, not free grants: deposit $25,000 to receive a $10,000 bonus, or deposit $50,000 to receive a $30,000 bonus; deposits and bonus credits are non-refundable and non-transferable. Every tier requires a company no later than Series A, a business email on the company's own domain, a live website, a real product or credible MVP with AI inference at its core, and a Runware account. Runware usually replies by email within a week. The program is equity-free. Earlier versions of this listing (verified 2026-09-30) described up to $30,000 in free API credits for 12 months; the current page no longer offers that, and it does not state when the terms changed.
- Claim steps: Check eligibility: bootstrapped or pre-seed, no later than Series A, a live product or credible MVP where AI generation is core, a business email on your company's own domain, and a live website. Personal email addresses are declined. | Create a Runware account first; Runware says credits are awarded to that account if you are accepted. | Apply at https://runware.ai/startup-program and select Starter as your tier. Give detailed product, traction and expected-usage evidence: the award is scored in $100 steps up to $1,000. | Expect an email reply, usually within a week. Starter credits go straight onto your Runware account and do not expire. | Do not mistake Growth/Scale for free credits: they require a non-refundable prepaid deposit ($25,000 for a $10,000 bonus; $50,000 for a $30,000 bonus).

The research hub (lambda.ai/research) hosts the apply-for-a-grant CTA and describes the program as research and mentorship; the $5,000 figure is stated on Lambda's CVPR 2026 page and ICLR 2026 blog, which point applicants back to lambda.ai/research. The ICLR post addresses independent researchers who need compute; the official pages reviewed do not require venture backing or state a card requirement. The linked application requires contact name/email, research problem, relevance/novelty, challenges, GPU compute needs, notable achievements, roadmap and publishing plan. Most early-stage startups receive between $25K and $100K upfront. Credits spend across AI Gateway, API Gateway, Metering and Billing, Mesh, and Event Gateway. After credits expire or for usage beyond the balance, accepted startups pay 50% of Konnect Plus list pricing for 24 months. Eligibility: typically pre-seed through Series A, under $10M total funding, in production or launching within 6 months. YC companies are pre-qualified for the full $100K plus the two-year discount. Kong reviews applications (typically within 5 business days); credits land within 24 hours of acceptance. Existing Kong customers who qualify can have their balance increased.

YC companies should indicate their batch. | Wait for Kong review (typically within 5 business days). | On acceptance, credits land in your Konnect org within 24 hours; the 50% discount auto-applies on invoices after credits run out.

Applicants must be at least 18, use a participating university email, and verify enrollment through SheerID. No credit card is required. Unused credits do not roll over. | To opt out of content use, open Settings → User → Application → Telemetry and Content, then disable Content Collection for Service Improvement.
### Kiro Startup Credits — up to 1 year Pro+
- Provider: Kiro
- Category: startup_program
- Amount: Up to 1 year of Kiro Pro+ credits (Starter ≤2 users / Growth ≤10 / Scale ≤30); credits expire 1 year after issuance; AWS Activate credit holders not eligible
- Status: active — enrollment deadline: 2026-12-31
- Last checked: 2026-11-10 — review_status=under-review · verification=social_proof · signup=required
- Source: https://kiro.dev/startups/
- Page: https://freetokens.custats.info/offers/kiro-startup-credits.html
- Summary: Kiro for Startups gives early-stage to Series A startups up to one year of Kiro Pro+ credits in three tiers (Starter ≤2 users, Growth ≤10, Scale ≤30). Applications are open April 7 – December 31, 2026. Requires an AWS Account ID with a business email matching the startup's domain; startups holding active AWS Activate credits are not eligible. Applicants must be 18 or older. Excluded residences: Argentina, Belarus, Brazil, China/GCR, Cuba, France, Germany, Iran, Italy, Mexico, North Korea, Poland, Russia, Spain, Syria, the region of Crimea, the so-called Donetsk People's Republic region (DNR), the so-called Luhansk People's Republic region (LNR), and the United Arab Emirates. Credits deposit to the AWS account on approval and expire 1 year after issuance; redeeming requires login via AWS IAM Identity Center. Choosing a plan above Pro+ or exceeding tier users can incur charges. Once credits are depleted, the AWS account automatically switches to standard Kiro Pro+ monthly billing on its card; continued use after expiry can also incur charges.
- Claim steps: Confirm early-stage to Series A eligibility, age 18+, and residence outside the excluded locations listed above (including France and Germany); active AWS Activate credit holders are not eligible. | Apply at aws.amazon.com/startups/credits/kiro with your AWS Account ID and business email matching your startup domain. | Choose a tier: Starter (≤2 users), Growth (≤10) or Scale (≤30). | On approval, credits are deposited to the AWS account and activate on provisioning. | Access Kiro via AWS IAM Identity Center (not Builder ID or social logins) to redeem credits. | Stay within the chosen tier and Pro+ plan. Monitor credits and stop/cancel unwanted billable access before depletion or expiry: standard Kiro Pro+ monthly billing starts automatically when credits run out.
